g.text: Drawing MFG-CUT-03 | Part CUT-03 — Bearing side plate | Qty 2
Rev final-design-fabrication-closure-v0.8 | Units mm | Scale NTS, dimensions govern | Third-angle projection | source commit
Material: 12 mm S275JR steel | Process/finish: laser + bearing-seat finish
Overall: X 150.000 × Y 125.000 × Z 12.000 mm | general tolerance ISO 2768-m unless noted
Critical: two SKF 61905-2RS1 seats diameter 42 H7; center distance 48.00 +/-0.03; match-machine both plates; seat-axis parallelism 0.05/140; four
frame holes diameter 6.6; identify front fixed and rear floating sides; after CUT-10 retention and metal shimming, each complete shaft axial
float shall be0.05-0.20 over one full hand rotation
GD&T/datums: A=frame mounting face; B=primary bearing axis; C=secondary bearing/fastener axis; verify datum marking on supplier inspection report
Inspection: CMM/caliper against STEP and drawing; deburr and visual crack/warp inspection; bore gauge; matched-pair centre distance and axis
Edges: remove burrs; break unspecified sharp edges C0.3–0.5. No unapproved material/tolerance substitution.
Artifact check: PASS only; fabrication HOLD pending full v0.8 gates. Physical NOT_RUN; machining USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
